title: Rogue AI agents created fake online identities in another hacking attempt
content:
Yet more rogue AI agents from OpenAI and Anthropic have been caught attempting to hack real targets online without permission. The discoveries add to a growing list of previously unknown incidents that have alarmed AI safety experts and intensified pressure for greater oversight of frontier systems. 
According to a report from the UK's AI Security Institute, which evaluates frontier models from top AI labs before they are released, agents powered by OpenAI's GPT-5.6-Sol and Anthropic's Mythos 5 went "engaged in sustained, potentially harmful activity directed at real people and organisations." summary: Google plans to discontinue Assistant on phones, replacing it with Gemini for voice control, starting September 4. This change will likely impact how users interact with their devices. The reason for the switch was not specified in the report.

title: Reddit keeps its strange DMCA fight over Google search results alive
content: Reddit advances lawsuit accusing Perplexity AI of conspiring with web scraper.
summary: Reddit is continuing its lawsuit against Perplexity AI, accusing the company of conspiring with a web scraper to manipulate Google search results. The case involves allegations of copyright infringement and is being closely watched due to its implications for online content. The lawsuit is part of a broader trend of companies seeking to protect their intellectual property in the digital age.

title: Would you get tattooed just to interview at a 7-days-a-week AI startup?
content: LemonLime’s CEO got “carried away” with tattoo gimmick.
summary: LemonLime's CEO got a tattoo as part of a gimmick, sparking questions about the company's intense work culture. The AI startup reportedly operates 7 days a week. The incident has raised eyebrows about the company's demands on its employees.

title: New MCP specification addresses the main barrier to enterprise adoption
content: Plus, a new policy for the AI protocol ensures features aren't removed suddenly.
summary: A new MCP specification has been introduced to address the main barrier to enterprise adoption, and a policy for the AI protocol ensures that features aren't removed suddenly. This development aims to improve the adoption of AI technology in enterprises. The policy provides stability and consistency for users.

title: Live updates: Coinbase lets U.K. users trade U.S. equities. BTC trades near $65,000
content: Trump’s comments on jobs, inflation and a possible Strait of Hormuz deal have helped risk sentiment, but bitcoin’s next move depends on whether lower oil actually pulls Treasury yields and the dollar down.
summary: Coinbase has launched U.S. equity trading for its U.K. users, while Bitcoin is currently trading near $65,000. Market sentiment is being influenced by Trump's comments on jobs and inflation, with bitcoin's future trajectory dependent on the impact of oil prices on Treasury yields and the dollar.

title: Crypto firm RedotPay says it will defend itself ‘vigorously’ against Binance lawsuit
content: Binance alleged RedotPay poached customers from the crypto exchange in a lawsuit filed in Hong Kong.
summary: Crypto firm RedotPay has stated it will vigorously defend itself against a lawsuit filed by Binance in Hong Kong. Binance alleges that RedotPay poached customers from its crypto exchange.

title: Galaxy Digital shares slip 5% after second-quarter results
content: Helios produced data-center revenue for the first time with Phase I expected to generate about $80 million quarterly from Q3.
summary: Galaxy Digital's shares dropped 5% after its second-quarter results were released. Despite this, the company's Helios data center operation achieved its first revenue generation, with Phase I projected to bring in approximately $80 million quarterly starting in Q3.

title: Gold hits 6-week highs on China demand as Bitcoin ignores fresh S&P 500 record
content: Gold and US stocks stole the limelight on Wednesday as Bitcoin failed to gain significantly beyond $64,000.
summary: Gold prices have reached six-week highs due to demand from China, while US stocks have also performed well, and Bitcoin has failed to gain significant value beyond $64,000. This news may indicate a shift in investor interest towards traditional assets. The lack of movement in Bitcoin's price suggests a potential stagnation in the cryptocurrency market.

title: Fed’s Cook says she’d support rate hike if disinflation stalls
content: Federal Reserve Governor Lisa Cook said she is “prepared to act” if inflation remains too high above the Fed’s target rate.
summary: Federal Reserve Governor Lisa Cook stated she's prepared to act if inflation remains high above the target rate, indicating a potential rate hike. This is in response to the current state of disinflation. The decision aims to control inflation and stabilize the economy.

title: Saylor’s Strategy joins Coinbase, Morgan Stanley and more in pledging contributions to Trump Accounts
content: Trump Accounts will invest in mutual funds or ETFs that track the S&P 500 or another index of mainly U.S. equities.
summary: Trump Accounts will receive contributions from various entities, including Saylor's Strategy, Coinbase, and Morgan Stanley, to invest in US equities through mutual funds or ETFs. The investments will track indices such as the S&P 500. This move indicates a collaborative effort among major players in the financial and technology sectors.

NASA’s new dark energy space telescope can also detect killer asteroids   At the end of August, NASA is set to launch the Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope from Kennedy Space…
summary: NASA is set to launch the Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope, which can detect dark energy and killer asteroids. The launch is scheduled for the end of August from Kennedy Space. This telescope is a significant development in space technology.

title: Montana’s plan to become an experimental medical hub just pushed forward
content: As of this week in Montana, any biotech company with an experimental drug has a clear path to selling it to consumers. Companies whose drugs have been through preliminary testing—sometimes in as few as 10 healthy people—can pay $12,500 to apply to a newly established review board for approval. Once its treatment is rubber-stamped, the…
summary: Montana has established a review board that allows biotech companies to sell experimental drugs to consumers after preliminary testing, potentially with as few as 10 healthy participants, for a $12,500 application fee. This move aims to turn Montana into an experimental medical hub. The state's new approach could significantly impact the medical industry.

title: SpaceX has bought $329M worth of Tesla Megapacks so far this year
content: The purchase illustrates just how interconnected Elon Musk's universe of companies are.
summary: SpaceX has purchased $329M worth of Tesla Megapacks this year, showcasing the interconnection between Elon Musk's companies. This deal highlights the synergy between Musk's ventures, with Tesla's energy storage solutions supporting SpaceX's operations. The transaction demonstrates the growing ties between Musk's business interests.

title: SpaceX is barely Space and mostly X
content:
Privatize the profit, socialize the losses? | Image: Cath Virginia / The Verge, Getty Images	

Once, I had some questions about why SpaceX, Elon Musk's healthiest company, acquired xAI, his sickliest one. Now I have some questions about why we're calling the whole thing SpaceX.
Look, what we have here, by revenue, is primarily a telecom company and a company that rents compute, according to SpaceX's first quarterly earnings statement as a public company. The space sector of the business didn't break a billion dollars this quarter and contributed only a touch over 10 percent of the company's revenue. SpaceX remains its own biggest customer. There just aren't enough other people who want its rockets. And, I dunno, maybe if the rockets  …
Read the full story at The Verge.
summary: SpaceX, Elon Musk's company, has released its first quarterly earnings statement as a public company, showing that the space sector contributes only a small percentage of its revenue, with most of its revenue coming from telecom and compute rental services. The company remains its own biggest customer due to a lack of demand for its rockets. This raises questions about the company's identity and focus.

title: Reddit signals ominous upcoming "changes” for old.reddit.com
content: Reddit says the beloved site is used for some "bad behavior."
summary: Reddit announced upcoming changes to old.reddit.com, citing its use for bad behavior, although the nature of these changes is not specified. The community is awaiting further details on what this means for the platform. The changes may impact user experience and moderation.

title: SpaceX spooks investors with debut earnings report
content: Shares slide in pre-market trading even as group says its quarterly revenues nearly doubled.
summary: SpaceX's debut earnings report has caused investors to become cautious, with shares sliding in pre-market trading despite the company's quarterly revenues nearly doubling. This reaction may be due to concerns over the company's financials and future growth prospects. The report's impact on investor confidence is noteworthy, but not directly related to AI or crypto.

title: Chrome may get faster updates with no restart required
content: The last two versions of Chrome have included more patches than the previous 23 combined.
summary: Google Chrome's latest updates have included a significant number of patches, with the last two versions having more patches than the previous 23 combined. This could lead to faster updates with no restart required. The increased patch rate may improve browser security and performance.

title: SpaceX extends decline to 11% on lockup expiration and capex spending fears
content: The company reported no BTC sales in the second quarter, but shares fell before the open as investors focused on capital spending, free cash flow pressure and a looming insider lockup expiry.
summary: SpaceX's shares extended their decline due to investor concerns over capital spending, free cash flow pressure, and an upcoming insider lockup expiry. The company also reported no Bitcoin (BTC) sales during the second quarter.

title: NASA’s new dark-energy space telescope can also detect killer asteroids
content: At the end of August, NASA is set to launch the Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope from Kennedy Space Center in Florida. Its goal is to help us better understand how the universe works, from the glue-like dark matter that keeps galaxies together to the elusive dark energy that drives the expansion of the cosmos.…
summary: NASA is set to launch the Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope to study the universe, including dark matter and dark energy. The telescope will also be able to detect killer asteroids. This mission aims to improve our understanding of the cosmos.

title: Montana’s new “right to try” law can’t come soon enough for some
content: Kris DeVault is desperate. His son, Brody, was born in March 2023. It wasn’t long before he started to show signs of developmental delay, says DeVault. As time went on, Brody started missing key milestones in speech, movement, and coordination, he says. When Brody was around two and a half years old, a genetic test…
summary: A new 'right to try' law in Montana may bring hope to families like Kris DeVault's, whose son Brody has developmental delays. Brody was born in March 2023 and has been missing key milestones in speech, movement, and coordination. The law's implementation could be crucial for families seeking experimental treatments.
